source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for row in out:
        cells = [(c, v) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
        if len(cells) != 2:
            continue
        (left_c, left_v), (right_c, right_v) = cells
        if {left_v, right_v} in ({4, 7}, {1, 8}):
            row[right_c] = 0
            row[left_c + 1] = right_v
    return out
'''
